instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.mainInstruction: Think about when you slept yesterday — including any naps. Then, mark each sleep period on the timeline and rate its quality.

step1.title: Log Every Sleep Period
step1.horizontal: Select Sleep from the menu at the bottom, then place it on the Sleep timeline for every period you slept. This includes short daytime naps — anything where you fell asleep counts. Time you leave blank is treated as awake.
step1.vertical: Tap the (+) button in the bottom right to open the menu, select Sleep, then tap the Sleep timeline for every period you slept. Include short daytime naps. Time you leave blank is treated as awake.

step2.title: Rate Each Sleep Block's Quality
step2.horizontal: On the Sleep quality timeline, place a rating (Poor → Great) over each sleep block. Drag the edges to make the rating cover the full block.
step2.vertical: On the Sleep quality timeline, place a rating (Poor → Great) over each sleep block. Drag the edges to cover the full block.

step3.title: Submit Your Sleep Diary
step3.description: Once every sleep block has both a duration and a quality rating, tap Submit.
step3.submitHelp: Click to submit your completed sleep diary

instructions.undoHelp: Did you make a mistake? Reverse your last action
